verdict.rationale: Mastra provides workflow suspend/resume backed by storage to persist execution state across pauses (mastra-gh-4, mastra-docs-12), which supports resuming work after interruption, but there is no explicit evidence of durable-execution guarantees across process restarts/deploys, no mention of integrations with durable-execution engines (e.g., Temporal, Inngest), and no documented crash-recovery or checkpointing semantics for agents specifically.
